cv_text:
Jordan Ellis
Data Analyst
Leeds, UK

Summary
Data analyst with four years of experience turning sales and operations data into clear reports for managers.

Experience
Data Analyst, Northfield Retail, 2022 to now
- Built weekly sales dashboards in Power BI used by twelve store managers
- Wrote SQL queries to clean and join stock and sales tables
- Automated a monthly Excel report with Python, saving a day of work each month

Junior Analyst, Harbour Logistics, 2020 to 2022
- Tracked delivery times in Excel and shared findings with the operations team
- Helped move reporting from spreadsheets to a SQL database

Skills
SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, data cleaning, stakeholder communication

Education
BSc Mathematics, University of Leeds
job_description: We are hiring a Data Analyst to join our commercial team. You will build dashboards in Tableau or Power BI, write SQL to pull and clean data, and use Python for analysis and automation. You will work closely with stakeholders across finance and marketing, present findings clearly, and help design A/B tests. Experience with dbt, Snowflake and statistical analysis is a plus. You should be comfortable owning reporting end to end and explaining results to non-technical colleagues.

scan.summary: Sample reply from the user check: the CV covers SQL, Python and Power BI well; add A/B testing and Tableau where they are true.

critical_improvements.suggestion: Add a real figure to each bullet if you have one

keyword_suggestions.how_to_add: Only if you have run or helped with one

rewrite_suggestions.suggested_approach: Name the kind of data and the people who used your reports

quick_wins: Add Tableau if you have used it
cover_letter_points: Your dashboards for store managers match the reporting focus
Your Python automation matches the analysis and automation duty
Your work with operations shows stakeholder communication
